summary: Automate reviewed release staging and bundle construction.
details: Commits 0e6628be5203401ef7895a1a3cf28bd5776a33e4, 3f5eebe99689e0c1cae066d01edce6a057372672, 963f1abe00dc71ac31d58a00641decd1683bd594, and 8e427f107268aaf76064a9563593972a88f7b8a8 replace one-off release preparation with maintained specification generation, deterministic install-bundle construction, a resumable gated coordinator that binds the complete bundle tree through desktop and remote verification, and deterministic cross-repository Git fixtures.
operator_impact: Operators prepare one strict inputs file, obtain the existing independent review, and use the coordinator to finalize and preview deployment. Production execution still requires the exact release ID and an explicit execution flag.
